name: Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park
reason: National park on Broken Bay named by Wikivoyage and NPWS; walks, rock art, boat access.

name: Bobbin Head
reason: For: Wikivoyage section; boat hire, picnic area and information centre hub. Against: one source; a sub-site of Ku-ring-gai Chase, which is already a spot.

name: Kalkari Discovery Centre
reason: Visitor centre inside Ku-ring-gai Chase; one source, part of the park rather than a distinct draw.

name: West Head
reason: Headline lookout and Aboriginal-art area at the end of Ku-ring-gai Chase, named by Wikivoyage; a clear half-hour stop in its own right.

name: Aboriginal Heritage Walk (West Head)
reason: Loop walk at West Head; part of the West Head spot, not a separate draw.

name: Barrenjoey Lighthouse
reason: Heritage lighthouse reached by a headland walk with Broken Bay views; two counted sources.

name: Palm Beach
reason: Beach and village at the tip of the Northern Beaches, named by Wikivoyage; high interest (28k views).

name: Whale Beach
reason: Second-tier surf beach a guide recommends as a quieter stop (Wikivoyage).

name: Mona Vale Beach
reason: Long patrolled surf beach named by Wikivoyage; second-tier beach, same kind as other Northern Beaches spots already listed.

name: Warriewood Beach
reason: For: Wikivoyage calls it one of the most picturesque small beaches. Against: one source; a small sheltered beach with limited reason to go out of the way.

name: Curl Curl Rock Pool
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the ocean pool as a swimming spot; the pools are a Sydney signature. Against: one source; sits beside the listed Curl Curl Beach.

name: Pittwater
reason: Long inlet with no single visitor point; its places (Palm Beach, Church Point) are the spots.

name: Dee Why Lagoon
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the wetland for birdwatching. Against: one source; mostly viewed from the road and Long Reef, beside the listed Dee Why Beach.

name: Dural Lane Murals
reason: Small street murals in a suburban lane; minor, a few minutes' look.

name: Ku-ring-gai Wildflower Garden
reason: For: Wikivoyage lists it; open daily with bush walks. Against: one source, small local garden.

name: Rose Seidler House
reason: Open house museum of Harry Seidler's 1950 modernist house (Museums of History NSW), listed by Wikivoyage; 16k views.

name: Seven Little Australians Park
reason: Local bushland park in a suburb; recreation reserve, not a tourist stop.

name: Lindfield Rocks
reason: Local bouldering site; niche climbing use, not a general visitor draw.

name: Muru Mittigar
reason: For: two counted sources; bush-tucker and cultural tours at Rouse Hill. Against: bookings essential, operator-run cultural centre rather than a walk-up place.

name: Museums Discovery Centre
reason: Wikivoyage notes it was closed; collection storage with limited public access, so status unverified.

name: Rouse Hill House and Farm
reason: For: Museums of History NSW visitor page lists the estate, a rare intact colonial homestead. Against: no Wikivoyage entry; access by limited guided tours; opening days unconfirmed (page would not load).

name: Cattai National Park
reason: Hawkesbury national park with Cattai Farm heritage and canoeing; NPWS and Wikivoyage.

name: Marramarra National Park
reason: For: NPWS and Wikivoyage name it. Against: remote and rarely visited, reached mainly by boat or long walks; little for a half-hour stop.

name: Scheyville National Park
reason: National park near Windsor with the Scheyville migrant camp heritage walk; NPWS and Wikivoyage.

name: Dharug National Park
reason: National park north of Wisemans Ferry with the World Heritage Old Great North Road walk; NPWS and Wikivoyage.

name: Muogamarra Nature Reserve
reason: Open to the public only about six weeks a year on booked tours; not there whenever you arrive.

name: Old Great North Road
reason: For: World Heritage convict-built road, walkable, named by Wikivoyage and NPWS. Against: the walk lies inside Dharug National Park, which is kept, so it may be part of that spot.

name: Wisemans Ferry
reason: Hawkesbury village and river crossing, gateway to Dharug and Yengo; Wikivoyage. The ferry is the way across, the village is the place.

name: Tobruk Sheep Station
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the working farm with sheepdog and shearing shows. Against: one source; show times and current opening not verified; modest draw.

name: Brooklyn
reason: Hawkesbury River fishing and boating town, gateway to Ku-ring-gai Chase and Dangar Island; Wikivoyage.

name: Hawkesbury River
reason: Long river feature with no single access point; its towns (Brooklyn, Windsor, Wisemans Ferry) are the spots.

name: Windsor
reason: Historic colonial town on the Hawkesbury with Georgian buildings; Wikivoyage hub.

name: Richmond
reason: For: Wikivoyage covers the historic farming town. Against: one source; mainly an RAAF base and farm town with little for a half-hour stop.

name: RAAF Museum
reason: For: free aviation museum with historic aircraft. Against: no counted source found; on an air-force base with entry checks.

name: Hawkesbury Regional Museum
reason: Small local museum with one source; minor.

name: Tebbutt's Observatory
reason: Small heritage observatory site run as part of the local museum; limited opening, minor.

name: Australiana Pioneer Village
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the volunteer-run pioneer village with historic buildings. Against: open Sundays and bank holiday Mondays only, so not there whenever a visitor arrives.

name: Trees Adventure Grose River Park
reason: Operator (treetop adventure company), not a place.

name: Penrith
reason: Regional city and main base for the Nepean and western Sydney, with its own Wikivoyage chapter; 40k views.

name: Nepean River
reason: Long river with no single visitor point; Penrith and its riverside parks cover it.

name: Penrith Whitewater Stadium
reason: Olympic whitewater course open to the public for rafting and kayaking; Wikivoyage and sydney.com.

name: Sydney International Regatta Centre
reason: For: Olympic rowing lake open daily outside event days, Wikivoyage. Against: one source; mostly a sports venue with events, little to see on a walk.

name: Western Sydney Parklands
reason: A park system spread across western Sydney, not one place; its attractions (Sydney Zoo, TreeTops, Chang Lai Yuan) are judged on their own.

name: WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo
reason: Darling Harbour wildlife zoo, open daily (about 10 am to 4-5 pm per ticket listings); sydney.com names it. Sits in the existing Sydney area but is not yet listed.

name: Sydney Motorsport Park
reason: Racing circuit whose public side is paid driving experiences, track days and event meetings run by the operator; no walk-up visit whenever you arrive.

name: Sydney Action Park
reason: No counted source; seasonal water park whose current operation is unconfirmed.

name: TreeTops Adventure Park
reason: Operator (aerial rope course), not a place.

name: Cables Wake Park
reason: Operator (cable wakeboard park), not a place.

name: Experiment Farm Cottage

name: Hambledon Cottage

name: Brislington House
